insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 334% to ₹156.8 Cr with EBITDA of ₹117.9 Cr (75.2%) and PAT of ₹43.9 Cr, after the 1,024 B200 GPUs went live and were nearly fully used. About 5,100 GPUs are live, with another 1,024 B200s due in the next couple of months; debt is about ₹450 Cr and will rise. Management again gave no revenue or MRR guidance but called current margins sustainable, raised GPU and CPU prices partly on higher memory costs, and is pushing a 'sovereign AI' platform built on open-source models.

what_changed.text: First B200 cluster live and on revenue
Price increases for GPU and CPU capacity; customers offered longer contracts to lock prices
New subsidiaries: SovCloud (infrastructure) and a Delaware entity for international sales
Borrowings of ~₹450 Cr taken for B200s

analyst_questions.answer: Mostly more capacity and utilisation; pricing had a modest effect.
Previous quarter: India AI Mission ~20-21%, international ~37%.
About ₹450 Cr now, rising with the next lot; no peak debt figure.
No MRR guidance; look at past exit MRR.

red_flags.text: Debt rising to fund GPUs (₹450 Cr and growing), with no stated limit.
Still no revenue or MRR guidance.
A 75% EBITDA margin depends on near-full utilisation of a small GPU base.
Questions on use of past preferential issue funds not fully answered on the call.
